speedModifier.description: Game clock speed. Fruit flight, gravity and the spawn timer all scale with it: 0.6 is slow motion, 1.5 is 50% faster. Applies immediately and holds across restarts.

spawnIntervalMultiplier.description: Time between launches, as a multiple of the game's own ramp (a fruit every 4 s at the start, down to every 0.4 s from 80 points). Higher is calmer: 2 doubles the gap, 0.5 halves it. Applies immediately.

bombDensity.description: Share of spawned bombs that are kept (1 = the game's default; 0 = no bombs). Slashing a bomb ends the run. Removed bombs are logged as BOMB_REMOVED with their SPAWN id, since the game logs SPAWN before the shim removes them. Applies to new spawns.
